description: This file defines the internal class HistogramAggregator used within the Orleans Runtime to accumulate and report histogram metrics, including bucket counts, total count, and sum.

classes.name: HistogramAggregator
classes.description: An internal class used for aggregating histogram data in Orleans, managing buckets, counts, and sums.

methods.name: HistogramAggregator
methods.description: Constructor initializing buckets, tags, and label-getting function.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a numeric observation, assigning it to the appropriate bucket and updating total count and sum.

methods.name: CollectBuckets
methods.description: Yields collected measurements for each bucket.

methods.name: CollectCount
methods.description: Returns a measurement of the total count of recorded observations.

methods.name: CollectSum
methods.description: Returns a measurement of the total sum of recorded observations.
